items.text:
nice game
has a good scifi vibe. 
good sound, beside the darker tracks.
Like the ship building and systems.

little complicato.
takes time and ytube to understand.
needs improvement in regard to graphics and how to interact (for ex. layers for building - would like to see the floors only to fix airleaks due to miss clicking;).
Would love to see a real spaceflight from outside of the ship.

what is really not good; 
it has a very hard start due to the character creation, normally either you end up with a young character with near to no skills and very bad traits OR you end up with an old better character (40-50) which then just gets problems like slow/artritis/not healthy/etc. Both lead to a lenghty gameplay at the start.
This makes to me no sense, since i like to enjoy a nice game play..with later arising problems.
Devs should think about a certain difficulty curve later in the game. At start i think you need a good performing character to build your dream ship, what is my goal.

I would wish from the devs to implement an easy mode option in the main menu at start or during character creation, where then a decent character can be created to start with (+10-20k money at least).

If found a solution via the F3 menu to completely pimp and edit my character & money based on the devs own redit post. But this should not be the way to go. Since i do like a good start, just make it possible in the game as an option.

Thanks anyways for the great game.

Ps. please improve the graphics..my eyes hurt and cant see the girls and spaceships nice contours:)
items.text_zh:
不错的游戏
有很好的科幻氛围。
音效不错，除了那些更阴暗的曲目。
喜欢飞船建造和系统。

有点复杂。
需要花时间和上YouTube才能理解。
在画面和交互方式上需要改进（例如，建造时的图层——希望能只看到楼层，以便修复因误点造成的漏气；）。
很想看到从飞船外部进行的真实太空飞行。

真正不好的地方；
由于角色创建，开局非常艰难，通常你要么得到一个几乎没有技能且特质非常糟糕的年轻角色，要么得到一个年纪较大、更好的角色（40-50岁），但随后就会出现迟钝/关节炎/不健康等问题。两者都会导致开局阶段游戏时间漫长。
这对我来说毫无意义，因为我喜欢享受良好的游戏体验……问题应该在后期才出现。
开发者应该考虑在游戏后期设置一定的难度曲线。开局时我认为你需要一个表现良好的角色来建造你梦想中的飞船，而这是我的目标。

我希望开发者能在开局的主菜单中或角色创建期间加入一个简单模式选项，这样就可以创建一个像样的角色来开局（至少+10-20k金钱）。

我通过F3菜单找到了一个解决方案，可以根据开发者自己的Reddit帖子完全强化和编辑我的角色与金钱。但这不应该是可行之道。因为我确实喜欢一个好的开局，就把它作为游戏中的一个选项实现吧。

无论如何，感谢这款很棒的游戏。

附言：请改进画面……我的眼睛疼，而且看不清女孩和飞船漂亮的轮廓:)
